strategic_assessment.headline: Outreach before conversion is backwards — we're pitching before we can close
strategic_assessment.body:
Three things are true this week that pull in different directions. Your content flywheel hasn't started but your outreach is live. That's backwards, because social proof before POSSIBLE would have made every Nell email land harder. The funnel has 13 breaks and zero paying clients, which means more outreach volume isn't the lever right now, fixing conversion is.

Leo identified the problem: no prices on Sprint pages, dead schema.org markup indexing wrong products at wrong prices, CTAs going nowhere. These aren't edge cases — they're the entire funnel. Nobody can buy even if they want to. Nell's drafting 15 Tier 1 emails to senior media execs, but if one of them clicks through to themindmaker.ai, they hit a broken experience.

The correct sequencing: fix the three funnel breaks this week, then open the floodgates. Outreach without conversion infrastructure is just noise.
strategic_assessment.recommended_focus: Deprioritize new channels and volume plays. Focus Leo and Arlo on shipping the three funnel fixes before anything else reaches a prospect. Everything else can wait 72 hours.

external_signals.signal: Addy (Canadian fractional real estate platform) collapsed 3 weeks ago — platform trust is an active concern in fractional ownership
external_signals.relevance: Fractionl Circle is entering a market where the most recent news cycle was a platform failure. Trust and transparency messaging needs to be explicit, not assumed.
external_signals.recommended_action: Maya should lead messaging with 'how we're different from Addy' positioning in all beta outreach. 6-8 week window before the news cycle moves on.
